newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH ZPS ZLIN ISSUES CZK 1.0 BLN, 5-YR BOND -PSE.
newsitem.headline: CZECH ZPS ZLIN ISSUES CZK 1.0 BLN, 5-YR BOND -PSE.

text.p: Czech machinery maker ZPS Zlin a.s. on Tuesday issued a one billion crown tranche of five-year bonds with a fixed annual coupon of 12.0 percent, the Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) said.
The PSE added the bonds were issued at par with their 100,000 crown nominal value.
The PSE said in a statement that the bonds were callable, but did not specify at what point ZPS could exercise this option.
ZPS Zlin officials were not immediately available for comment.
According to preliminary results provided by the PSE, ZPS Zlin posted a gross profit of 94 million crowns in 1996, up from 60 million the previous year.
